Corollary
[WMP for bounded weak subsolutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0180 1. ch12:12.20\group Weighted Energy Maximum Principles

On a complete noncompact manifold with a negative quadratic Ricci lower bound, every bounded weak heat subsolution with nonpositive initial data is nonpositive. Consequently bounded weak heat solutions are unique.

Proof

\sketch ↗ def:negative-quadratic-ricci-lower-bound ↗ thm:static-weak-subsolution-wmp Bishop–Gromov comparison gives $\Vol B(O,r)\leq ae^{br^2}$. If $|u|\leq C_1$, decomposition into unit annuli gives

\[ \int _0^T\! \int _M e^{-\alpha d^2}u_+^2 \leq aC_1^2T\sum _{r\geq 1}e^{br^2-\alpha (r-1)^2}<\infty \]

for $\alpha >b$. Theorem 1.4 applies. Uniqueness follows by applying it to both signs of the difference.

□
